svg.text: Runtime interaction flow: SRE Agent to Tenant License Optimization MCP Bridge
One user request from prompt to final response, with each solution part and its purpose in the step.

foreignObject.div: Analyze tenant license consumption, inactive licensed users, and recommendations.
SRE Agent decides the request needs external MCP tools.
Chooses a license or EnterpriseMCP-style Graph tool.
Entra validates identity/app role and issues JWT.
Checks signature, issuer, audience, and caller client ID.
User-assigned identity obtains app-only Graph token.
License inventory, assignments, sign-in and directory data.
Calculates utilization, inactive users, and recommendations.
Summarizes findings and next actions in chat.
